title: Why this page, and why it narrowed
body: The premise check found one job no other page covers: writing a markdown component, from declaring it to seeing it in the editor's picker and on the public page. A scaffold already ships a working `createRenderer` call, and the reference page lists its options, so the rest of "configure rendering" had no reader.
The page now takes a developer through one `event` component: its attributes, slots, `build` function, picker entry, and registration. The outline's job and covers lines were rewritten to match.

title: Rename the page to match its job?
body: The page teaches one task, writing a markdown component, and keeps the outline's title, Configure rendering. A reader looking for how to add a component may not open a page with that title.
Renaming changes the page's slug, so the outline entry and every link to it change with it.

choices.label: Rename to Write a markdown component
choices.done: The session renames the page, its outline entry, and its slug, and updates the links before drafting.

choices.label: Keep Configure rendering
choices.done: The title stays as the outline has it.

title: Keep the DaisyUI class-name caution?
body: One bullet warns that DaisyUI generates CSS for any of its class names (such as `card-body`) it finds in scanned source, so a component's inner classes need names that match none of them (`f:34wt4f`). It is a real trap for a scaffolded site, which ships DaisyUI.
It is a claim about DaisyUI's behavior, so no code in this repo confirms it, and the fact-check returned it as unsupported.

choices.label: Keep the caution
choices.done: The bullet stays, sourced to its fact.

choices.label: Cut the caution
choices.done: The bullet goes, and the section says nothing about class names.

title: Heading left as it is
body: The register review suggested renaming this heading to Component markdown, as a soft finding. The session kept it, since the published Configure rendering page already uses this heading and other pages may link its anchor. Tell me in a note if you want the rename.
